figures.derivation: 13,115,000 non-UK-born at 30 June 2024, Table 9 of the ONS long-term international migration spreadsheet and Table 3 of the bulletin it accompanies, divided by the accredited mid-2024 UK population of 69,281,400 is 18.93%, shown as 18.9%. ONS publishes no such share.
